title: Going Cashless
theme: Pizza Day 2024 · CBDC / cashless state / cypherpunk freestyle
description: B-side to If It Wasn’t For Satoshi in a back-to-back Pizza Day 2024 pair (homage to Laszlo’s two large pizzas). Written as raw hip-hop freestyle — no hook, just bars — about the push to remove cash and corral people into UBI and state-backed tokenomics, hinted as a new slave mechanism.
